name: textoverlay-videomasking
title: Text Overlay Video Mask
description: One line of oversized bold italic text works as a cut-out window, so a nature clip moves inside the letterforms while everything around them stays near-black.
use: A hero or section title should carry motion and atmosphere without a full video block behind it.
avoid: The video is a remote full-resolution file that streams on a loop, so a slow link leaves the letters black.
a11y: The looping video ignores reduced-motion preferences, and nothing labels the clip for screen readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide near-black panel holds a single line of large, heavy italic lettering with an underline stroke. The strokes are not a solid colour: they are filled with blue and green foliage footage, so the word shimmers while the surrounding panel is flat black.
behaves: The clip inside the letters plays on a loop from the moment the panel loads, brightening and shifting as the camera moves over greenery. Nothing reacts to the pointer; the panel itself never changes shape or size.
customise: The word and the video address are written into the file and there are no props, so swapping the copy or the clip means editing the source.
weight: moderate: A full-resolution remote video decodes and loops the whole time it is on screen.
